  static Double readNumericNullable(BComponent comp, String name, Map<String,String> statusOut)
  {
    String code = "x";
    if (statusOut != null) statusOut.put(name, code);
    return null;
  }

  {
    String code = "y";
    if (statusOut != null) statusOut.put(name, code);
    return null;
  }
